svg.title: Event sequence across one PWM period with TIM1 CCR4 set to 2625
svg.desc: TIM1 crosses 2625 at 10.94 microseconds, raising OC4REF and resetting TIM2 and TIM4. Both GETSENS pins pulse for one microsecond, the BiSS frames complete in about 3.4 microseconds, TIM4 channels 2 and 3 request both SPI read-outs at 16.94, data is resident by 19.6, the injected converter fires at 31.17 just before the peak, and the FOC ISR runs from 32 to about 37. TIM2 emits twenty trigger pulses across the period with a gap centred on the peak.
